{
  "function": "() => {
  const links = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('a'));
  const gmLink = links.find(a => a.textContent.trim() === '4A GM30315');
  if (!gmLink) return 'link not found';

  // Let's find the row or container of this link
  let container = gmLink;
  while (container && container.parentElement && container.parentElement !== document.body) {
    // Check if container has price inputs
    const inputs = container.querySelectorAll('kat-input, input');
    if (inputs.length >= 2) break; // found row container
    container = container.parentElement;
  }

  // Find all inputs within container
  const inputs = Array.from(container.querySelectorAll('kat-input, input'));
  
  return {
    containerTag: container.tagName,
    containerClass: container.className,
    containerText: container.innerText.slice(0, 300),
    inputs: inputs.map(i => ({
      tagName: i.tagName,
      value: i.value,
      placeholder: i.placeholder,
      id: i.id,
      name: i.name,
      outerHtml: i.outerHTML.slice(0, 100)
    }))
  };
}",
  "pageId": 1,
  "waitForStableDom": false
}
